name: THBKG
description: The Temporal Heterogeneous Biomedical Knowledge Graph (THBKG) v2, built from Open Targets 26.09 with Gene Ontology, Reactome, IntAct, the Human Protein Atlas, ChEMBL and ClinicalTrials.gov. Every evidence edge carries the year it was first observed, so the graph can be read as of any past decision year, as a continuous event stream or as yearly snapshots. 110,220 nodes (target, disease, molecule, GO term, Reactome pathway) and 14.1M edge rows over 19 relations. Three benchmark tasks score year Y on evidence dated before Y: T1 discovery (a target-disease pair's first clinical trial), T2 hypothesis (a pair's first direct link is a literature co-mention) and T3 advancement (a pair entering Phase II reaches Phase III).
citeAs: Siu, Cabrera, Mudaliar, and Zubiaga. THBKG: A Temporal Biomedical Knowledge Graph for Leak-Free Clinical Advancement Prediction.

creator.name: Queen Mary University of London; Recursion Pharmaceuticals

rai:dataCollection: Derived from public releases: Open Targets Platform 26.09 evidence (pinned in source_versions.json), Gene Ontology, Reactome, IntAct, Human Protein Atlas v25, ChEMBL 37 biotherapeutic sequences and ClinicalTrials.gov trial dates. Each evidence row is dated by its publication, study or trial date.
rai:dataLimitations: Dates are evidence dates as curated in Open Targets 26.09, not the dates evidence entered the databases. A pair first trialled or co-mentioned after the decision year counts as a negative, so precision is a lower bound. Literature co-mentions are text-mined and include passing mentions.
rai:dataBiases: New links favour well-studied targets: a target-popularity prior is a strong baseline. Clinical and literature evidence over-represents oncology and other heavily studied therapeutic areas.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. Aggregate gene, disease, drug and trial records; no individual-level data.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking time-aware link prediction for target discovery, hypothesis generation and clinical advancement; not validated for clinical decision making.

recordSet.name: discovery
recordSet.description: T1: a pair is a positive in its first_trial_year, ranked among the targets with no trial for the disease before that year.

field.name: target_id
field.description: Ensembl gene id of the target.

field.name: disease_id
field.description: Open Targets disease id (MONDO, EFO, HP or Orphanet).

field.name: target_index
field.description: Index of the target in mappings/target.parquet and the graph tensors.

field.name: disease_index
field.description: Index of the disease in mappings/disease.parquet and the graph tensors.

field.name: first_trial_year
field.description: Year the pair's first clinical trial (any phase) started.

field.name: first_trial_phase
field.description: Phase weight of the pair's strongest trial in that year (0.01 unknown, 0.05 early Phase 1, 0.1 Phase 1, ... 1.0 approved).

field.name: max_outcome_phase
field.description: Highest phase grade among the pair's finished trials by the end of the graph; empty while none has finished.

field.name: grade
field.description: NDCG gain: max_outcome_phase, or 0.5 when no trial has finished. Looks past the decision year: for scoring only.

recordSet.name: hypothesis
recordSet.description: T2: a pair is a positive in its first_direct_year when novel, ranked among the targets with no direct edge of any relation to the disease before that year.

field.name: target_id
field.description: Ensembl gene id of the target.

field.name: disease_id
field.description: Open Targets disease id (MONDO, EFO, HP or Orphanet).

field.name: disease_index
field.description: Index of the disease in mappings/disease.parquet and the graph tensors.

field.name: first_direct_year
field.description: Year of the pair's first direct edge of any relation, trials included.

field.name: novel
field.description: True when that first edge is a literature co-mention: the positives.

field.name: first_literature_year
field.description: Year of the pair's first literature co-mention; empty if never.

field.name: first_other_evidence_year
field.description: Year of the pair's first non-literature, non-trial evidence; empty if never.

field.name: first_trial_year
field.description: Year of the pair's first clinical trial; empty if never.

field.name: literature_repeated
field.description: The literature score rose again in a later year: another paper co-mentioned the pair.

field.name: target_prior_diseases
field.description: Diseases the target had a direct edge to before first_direct_year.
